Participating in the sessions on Outcome Based Education provided by NITTTR was a truly enriching experience. The course was outstanding in its depth and clarity, offering invaluable insights. I'm grateful for the opportunity to be part of this exceptional program.

The short term course on 'Outcome Based Education' was an enlightening experience. It provided practical strategies for applying OBE principles in teaching and assessment, thanks to expert instructors and interactive sessions. The well-structured program offered a conducive learning environment and a focus on Education 4.0. The course's thought- provoking modules provided valuable insights into POs, COs, and OBE methodologies.
Darshan Dave Assistant Professor (Mathematics) Member, Internal Quality Assurance Cell, Parul University.
